answer: The groover cuts the croze where the head sits, and the groove must be deep enough to hold but never through. Cooper fir stave splitter ash patent covers the grooving: a patent fir stave splitters file after splitting yard reviews. The thread is the first groove, cut at the bench; the reef is the last, cut before the head is seated, and the lagoon is the bench itself, grooved by a hundred cuts. A cheat must cut 31 false grooves and seat 31 false heads.
